definitions.explanation: Describes movement, reactions, or manner that is slow, heavy, and lacking agility. Often implies a negative quality of being unresponsive or unwieldy.

examples.japanese: {鈍重|どんじゅう}な{動|うご}き
{彼|かれ}の{反応|はんのう}は{鈍重|どんじゅう}だった。
{官僚|かんりょう}{組織|そしき}の{鈍重|どんじゅう}さが、{改革|かいかく}を{妨|さまた}げている。
examples.english: The sluggishness of the bureaucracy is hindering reform.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {鈍重|どんじゅう}な{組織|そしき}.

NOUN FORM: {鈍重|どんじゅう}さ (sluggishness, slowness)

NUANCE: {鈍重|どんじゅう} carries negative connotations of being slow and unwieldy. It's often used critically for bureaucracies, organizations, or people who lack responsiveness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}な{動|うご}き (slow movement)
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}な{反応|はんのう} (sluggish reaction)
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}な{組織|そしき} (ponderous organization)
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}さ (sluggishness)

RELATED WORDS:
- {鈍|にぶ}い (dull, slow)
- {緩慢|かんまん} (slow, sluggish - similar)
- {のろい (slow, sluggish - more casual)
- {機敏|きびん} (nimble, quick - opposite)
- {俊敏|しゅんびん} (agile, swift - opposite)
